pins: protocol-survey.md §2 -- the three hash primitives at every input length across two block boundaries
rule: Every value below was returned by a function in reference/. Nothing here is hand-computed. Regenerate rather than edit.
schedule_note: Every input is recorded in its vector. It was constructed as sha256(label || ull_to_bytes(i, 8)) with the label given per source in the `schedule` block -- both reference calls, the idiom group_c_addr.json's crc16_base58_corpus uses -- and a 32-byte value wider than one digest is the concatenation of that digest for successive sub-counters. The schedule is documentation; the loader never applies it.

schedule.sha256: in: "HS sha256" filled by 32-byte chunks "HS sha256/k"
